🚨 In May, NHS England took a victory lap. By July, the waiting list was rising again.

7.4 million procedures now waiting - up 34,000 in a month, the highest since March. The Government's own 65% 18-week target: missed, at 61.3%. And July's doctors' strike cancelled another 50,000 appointments, on top of 171,776 lost last year.

A new Prime Minister doesn't change the trajectory. Changing what isn't working does.
